packageRules.description: Group all Pangolin role dependencies together
Pangolin's Docker tags are prefixed with ee- (e.g. ee-1.21.0); teach Renovate to parse them as semver so EE updates are detected
Group all Immich role dependencies together

flip-planning is our own image: follow its published releases, not the :main recipe image which is rebuilt on every merge. semver versioning is what makes Renovate ignore main, latest, sha-xxxxxxx and the floating 1.2 tag that the publish workflow also pushes: only a full X.Y.Z is a version

Minor and patch releases automerge once the lint workflow passes. Merging on main triggers the deploy workflow, so this really is an automatic deployment: it is allowed because the version contract promises a minor or a patch needs no operator action

A major is never deployed on its own: it may change the YAML scenario format, drop an environment variable, or carry an irreversible Flyway migration that a rollback to the previous image will not undo. It waits to be ticked on the dependency dashboard

customManagers.description: Track the flip-planning image pinned in the Ansible role defaults (plain var, no manager covers it)
